key.name: effect-enabled
key.description: Whether the color filter effect is active on the desktop.

key.name: preset
key.description: Current active color filter preset (off, amber, green, cyan, sepia, grayscale).

key.name: intensity
key.description: Effect intensity strength scaled from 0.0 to 1.0.

key.name: restore-state
key.description: Whether to automatically restore active effect when user logs in.

key.name: click-action
key.description: Behavior of primary click on top panel indicator (cycle, toggle, menu).

key.name: show-osd
key.description: Whether to show on-screen display notifications when intensity is changed.
